comments.overrides: jwks-rsa (a firebase-admin dependency) is CommonJS and does `require('jose')`. jose v6 is ESM-only, so on Vercel every route importing firebase-admin died with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM at import time — an empty 500 before any handler ran. jose v5 ships both CJS and ESM entry points and still exports importJWK/exportSPKI, the only two functions jwks-rsa uses. Remove this pin once jwks-rsa ships an ESM-compatible release.
